critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 494 lines and still tolerable but bordering the split threshold. Consider splitting Opportunity Engine routes (SSR pages + api_router endpoints) into a dedicated module (routes_opportunities.py) as more features are added.
MongoDB write for demo_saved_searches and demo_operation_intents has no unique constraint per session; will grow unbounded. Add TTL index or per-session cap before opening to real traffic.

GET /api/opportunities exposes precio_min/precio_max but the SSR filter form previously sent empty strings which crashed FastAPI Optional[int] parsing (422). Fixed by accepting Optional[str] and coercing via _to_int_or_none. Same pattern was proactively applied to /oportunidades to prevent same class of bug for empty precio_min/precio_max/sup_min.
detalle acuerdos redirect returns 302 (not 301) which is fine for gating, but /oportunidades/no-existe returns 404 with inline HTML — consider using the base template for a consistent 404 page.
interest-signals threshold is hardcoded (3). Move to config/env for tuning.
seed_data_creation: None. Test writes ephemeral demo_favorites / demo_operation_intents / demo_saved_searches docs per anonymous session; no cleanup needed as they carry generated session ids.

rca of the issue: Bug found: submitting the catalog filter form (with 'Aplicar') generated URL query params 'precio_min=' and 'precio_max=' (empty strings). FastAPI could not coerce empty string to Optional[int] and returned HTTP 422 for the SSR /oportunidades endpoint, resulting in an error page with 0 cards and no sort/filter-clear/filter-more controls. Reproduction: GET /oportunidades?tipo=REO&precio_min=&precio_max= → 422. Mitigation applied: changed the /oportunidades and /api/opportunities handlers to accept precio_min/precio_max/sup_min as Optional[str] and coerce via a shared _to_int_or_none() helper that treats '' and non-numeric as None. Verified fix by re-running backend suite (27/27 pass) and Playwright REO filter flow (5 cards + URL persists).
